faq: How much does Retell AI cost?
Retell AI is pay as you go: $0.07 to $0.31 per minute for voice agents, with no monthly fee. Its default setup in Retell's own estimator comes to $0.15 per minute.
You start with $10 in free credits. After that you pay per minute used.
What makes the price per minute go up?
The AI model is the biggest factor: from $0.0032 to $0.384 per minute. ElevenLabs voices ($0.04 to $0.10 per minute) also cost more than Retell's own voices ($0.015).
How many calls can run at once?
20 concurrent calls are free. Extra call lines cost $8 each per month.
